entityDescription:
Obortech’s Smart Hub provides all actors in the supply chain with an ecosystem in which they can operate in a fair, transparent, secure, flexible, and cost-efficient environment. Obortech offers its clients IoT sensors and blockchain-based peer-to-peer data verification. The Smart Hub is like a social network, allowing all participants to keep track of the delivered goods at any given moment using measurements taken from IoT sensors and peer-to-peer verified data uploaded in real-time to the hub and secured via blockchain technology, preventing any tampering of the information. Obortech’s Smart Hub is making supply chains visible for consumers and distributors, offering consumers detailed insights on their purchases, allowing them to make information-based choices on their food purchases. By using blockchain and IoT technology, Obortech will enable a reduction in food waste in supply chains, contributing to the EU’s action plan for 2030. Through constant monitoring of data, that is gathered by the IoT sensors and recorded on the blockchain, actors in the supply chain can receive information on faults in the supply chain (e.g., temperature change, sealing break, etc.) and react in real-time, thus preventing food waste.
The Smart Hub intro: https://youtu.be/mybaRPxLi7A
The Smart Hub demo: https://www.obortech.io/smart-hub
The Obortech’s pitch deck: https://bit.ly/3BRKobl
Obortech has collaborated with several food companies to test its technology in a fully operational environment. In collaboration with a logistic company in Mongolia (Mongolian Express LLC) and apple farms in Germany (Elbe-Obst), Obortech has beta tested its technology for delivering apples from Germany to Mongolia. The results gathered from the tests provided relevant feedback for further development. Obortech has also won the Polish Startup program, the Poland Prize, and received �‎50K grant for a soft landing in the Polish market. Furthermore, the company has collaborated with several companies in Poland, Germany, and Mongolia to test its technology in the meat and mining supply chains, validating the company’s technology through numerous use cases. The Smart Hub use cases: https://blog.obortech.io. Obortech has 10 awards & recognitions from multinational organizations such as Microsoft, Amazon, PwC, World Bank, MIT Accelerator & Poland Prize, Fruit Logistica, Berlin Partner, etc. See the full award and partner list: https://bit.ly/3HIjVhy

entityDescription:
Developing magnetic principle-based propulsion systems (engines) for all mobility applications. These propulsion devices do not require any mechanical moving components and are maintenance free. They are powered by renewable electric energy.

TOMO has invented and developed propulsion systems that operate in the field of magnetic physics. An array of electrically generated magnetic fields interact with each other and interact with the momentum of inertia of the generator (Test-Object) itself. By doing so, a scalable force (measured in Newton) acts on the generator and pushes it forwards or backwards.

The magnetic propulsion systems from TOMO will be attached to the object that has to be moved (satellite, plane, ship, car, drone …). There are no mechanical moving parts involved (no gearboxes, no rotating transmission shafts, etc).
Working technology demonstrators exist at TOMO and drive/move objects that float on water, are suspended in air, or roll on wheels. As this is a scalable technology, the lightest generator TOMO has built weights less than 150 grams, while larger generators weigh 5 kg and more.

entityDescription: Astrolight is a supplier of compact fiber-optical laser communication terminals for low Earth orbit satellites and optical ground stations. Core technologies developed by Astrolight include telecom fiber lasers and amplifiers, FPGA based laser fine pointing systems, FPGA based optical modems and telescope optical head assemblies for optical communication. Astrolight was founded in 2019 by researchers from the Center for Physical Sciences and Technology and Vilnius Tech University. It is a fully privately owned company whose shareholders are Lithuanian nationals. entityDescription:
SmartIR was founded to develop a commercial pathway for a patented graphene technology for adaptive emissivity and absorption of infrared (IR) and visible light.
SmartIR Ltd is currently developing a flexible, lightweight, and switchable graphene-based tile system for coating surfaces to control infrared emissivity and visible colour across a broad spectrum. Tiles enable control of thermal radiation on demand and can be connected together to cover large surfaces and controlled on a tile-by-tile basis.

Applications exist across the aerospace and space sectors with a primary market opportunity surrounding supporting thermal management solutions in the growing sector of NanoSat and MircoSat deployments.
There is a strong market pull for lightweight, flexible, thermal control systems for integration into nano- and microSatellites. This technology can be used for space suits to regulate the body temperature in the harsh environment of outer space.
In addition to aerospace, adaptive thermal tile (ATT) also has applications into thermal signature management for increased survivability and force protection against set-and-forget style weapons systems which target heat emissions for course guidance.

entityDescription:
Created in 2012, the “Institut Lafayette” is a platform for innovation and technology transfer in optoelectronics combining both high-level applied research and commercialization services.
As a nonprofit organization, “Institut Lafayette” aims to promote the development of technological components to meet industrial needs.
The innovation research and technology activities of “Institut Lafayette” focus in the area of new semiconductors materials, components and systems for optoelectronics. The scientific and technology heart of the platform is based on the growth of the new semi-conductor materials by thin-films MOVPE (Metal Organic Vapor Phase Epitaxy) and the microfabrication of microelectronic and optoelectronic devices in its own state of the art 1000 m2 cleanroom and laboratory. The expertise includes deposition, modeling, study and optimization steps of electric, optic and electronic characteristics in devices such as photodetectors, lasers, light-emitting diodes, transistors, photovoltaic cells and sensors.

entityName: ILUNION LIMPIEZA Y MEDIO AMBIENTE, S.A.
entityDescription:
GRUPO ONCE has been a benchmark company in Spain, specializing in the management of solutions for companies that outsource the management of their services. Alentis with more than 25 years of experience and specialized in large areas of activity -Cleaning-Environment, Security, Outsourcing, Fire-Driving, Integral Maintenance and Facility Services-, formed part of a multi-brand architecture with other companies such as Confortel, ServiMedia, Travel 2000, etc.

Today, all these companies have merged under a single brand, ILUNION, the new ONCE commitment to unite in the same direction and capitalize on the social value of all its companies that today operated through Fundosa and Ceosa. ILUNION materializes in the business sphere the social initiative of ONCE and its Foundation, with a pioneering and innovative model, which maintains the balance between its economic and social values. Thus, ILUNION is a benchmark in the creation of quality employment for people with disabilities in Spain and in which more than 36.770 people currently work, 43% of them with disabilities. It is a socially responsible business project that develops its activity in five divisions and 50 business lines with criteria of economic and social profitability.

Thus, under this objective, the company Ilunion Limpieza y Medio Ambiente, S.A. was born within ILUNION. that gathers and brings together all the experience of GRUPO ALENTIS in the management of Cleaning services through the company PILSA. Therefore, Ilunion maintains the contracts, as well as the technical and operational staff, and the material resources of PILSA, thus, it has more than 25 years of experience, being leaders in inclusion.

Ilunion offers integral cleaning solutions throughout the national geography. It has more than 9,000 professionals and offers a wide range of solutions in the following areas: Commercial Cleaning, Landscaping and Gardening, Pest Control, Waste Management and Building Maintenance.

entityDescription:
ClearSpace is a leading In-Orbit Servicing (IOS) company with a vision to enable a circular space economy by bringing maintenance and services to orbit. The company is developing advanced, inherently dual-use technologies for satellite disposal, inspection, and life-extension, supporting both institutional and commercial missions while contributing to the safe, secure, and sustainable use of the space environment.
ClearSpace in Luxembourg is currently leading Phoenix, a GEO life-extension mission designed to extend satellite lifetimes and PRELUDE a LEO a proximity & maneuvering mission, which strengthens ClearSpace’s in-orbit servicing portfolio and operational readiness.
Founded in Switzerland in 2018 and headquartered in Luxembourg, ClearSpace operates across Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Luxembourg, contributing to Europe’s resilience, strategic autonomy, and long-term space sustainability.

entityDescription:
When we say global, we mean global.
 
GSS recognizes that establishing a consistent global IT standard is challenging; especially if you are responsible for remote branch offices or production facilities across several continents.
 
We deliver wherever you are
When we talk about global deployment, we’re referring to virtually every country on every continent, with the exception of embargoed and war-torn regions. Whether it’s a datacenter in Secaucus, NJ supporting New York’s financial district or a local branch office in Nairobi, Kenya, GSS delivers wherever you are.
 
Reaching your milestones
The backbone of our Global Deployment solution is our in-house Export Desk. Our logistics experts provide ambitious but realistic deployment lead times. Managing expectations has proven to be the key element in reaching your project’s milestones. We are not only enthusiastic and resourceful but also dependable.With our extensive network of local partners, we reach locations all your locations and walk thelast mile of implementationwith you.
 
This is what we do:
At the heart of our in-house services we have our engineers, technicians and project managers. They take care of the pre-staging, asset tagging, imaging, Drop-in-the-box and CMDB reporting and management services. All our services are crafted to help solve all your global IT infrastructure challenges when it comes to standardization and centralization.
 
This is how we do it:
Vendor & Contract management – Establishing your global IT standard requires securing the best possible pricing model. GSS partners with all major OEMs to build a transparent contract structure and we follow a best-of-both-worlds model that harnesses the strength of the OEMs and the expertise of GSS.
 
Once our team has designed the perfect solution for your needs, we will facilitate the procurement process with a customized procurement portal featuring centralized order fulfilment, customized product portfolio, optional centralized/decentralized invoicing, asset management and detailed reporting tools.

entityDescription:
ABGi Poland is a Polish engineering company, founded in 2014, specialized in the management of innovation, with strong hands-on expertise in the SPACE business. With more than 20 years of experience across Europe acquired both in the Space Sector and Innovation Consulting, we have developed a pragmatic approach towards public institutions and private companies to support their growth strategy. Our competitive advantages: Direct access to major European space stakeholders and a network of more than 200 space organisations in Europe Senior experts from space institutions & industry. A result-oriented Polish team with a high commitment! Located in Warsaw, we propose our methods and knowledge from a long French experience to support the Polish economy. 
ABGi Poland can also boast of success in creating the brand which is SpaceHUB. These are monthly events that deal with the subject of space, satellite data, the possibilities of their use, implementation in projects and other aspects of the theme of space. Every month a different subject is presented, during which the experts present their solutions. Thanks to the dissemination activities, we have already gathered a large group of SpaceHUB fans. 
ABGi Poland is active in the area of hackathon organizations such as Climathon, Copernicus Hackathon and others. As part of the hackathon organization, ABGi Poland is responsible for the full process of task completion along with promotional and dissemination activities.

26th August 2014 : Creation of the company under the name Kapitech specializing in innovation management in the space business and consulting.
October 2019 : Acquisition of Kapitech by the AK Group II.
April2021 : Kapitech becomes Absiskey Polska, subsidiary office of Absiskey.
April 2024: Absiskey Polska become ABGi Poland.

entityDescription: Novaspace assists its clients with strategy, market development and innovation, as specialists in the space industry. Our broad array of services includes strategy and technology consulting, communication activities, and interdisciplinary project management mainly for public institutions (e.g. European Commission, European Space Agency, European GNSS Agency, European Parliament, National Ministries, etc.) in the space and space applications domain. Novaspace further engages in venture capital and provides business coaching for start-ups and SMEs. Novaspace’s areas of activity include space (earth observation, navigation, satellite communications, exploration and situational awareness), geo-information, security & defense, transportation & aviation, mobile & mobility, and energy. The team consists of experienced management and technology consultants with significant space (applications) experience and in-house experts. The strength of Novaspace lies in its ability to mobilize ad-hoc teams of consultants and experts to tackle specific issues.
